setup.description: Interactive project setup — detects your project, configures metaswarm, writes project-local files

start-task.description: Begin tracked work on a task with complexity assessment

prime.description: Load relevant knowledge from the BEADS knowledge base before starting work

review-design.description: Parallel design review gate — spawns PM, Architect, Designer, Security, and CTO agents to review a design document

design-review-gate.description: Automatic review gate that runs after brainstorming completes - spawns PM, Architect, Designer, Security, and CTO agents in parallel

orchestrated-execution.description: 4-phase execution loop for work units - IMPLEMENT, VALIDATE, ADVERSARIAL REVIEW, COMMIT

self-reflect.description: Extract learnings from recent work and update the knowledge base

handoff.description: Write a self-contained handoff document so a fresh agent can resume the work

pr-shepherd.description: Monitor a PR through to merge - handles CI failures, reviews, and thread resolution

status.description: Show current project setup status and available tools

external-tools-health.description: Check health of external tools (BEADS, GitHub, CI)

issue-orchestrator.description: Main coordinator per issue — spawns sub-agents, runs 4-phase execution loop

architect-agent.description: Reviews technical architecture and creates implementation plans

product-manager-agent.description: Reviews design documents for use case clarity, user benefits, and product alignment

designer-agent.description: Reviews designs for UX, API design, and developer experience quality

security-design-agent.description: Reviews designs for security vulnerabilities and attack surface before implementation

cto-agent.description: Reviews plans for TDD readiness, codebase alignment, and risk before implementation

coder-agent.description: TDD implementation of features and fixes

code-review-agent.description: Internal code review before PR creation

researcher-agent.description: Codebase exploration and prior art research

security-auditor-agent.description: Security vulnerability detection and OWASP compliance review of implemented code

knowledge-curator-agent.description: Knowledge extraction and curation from completed work

pr-shepherd-agent.description: PR lifecycle management through to merge

release-engineer-agent.description: Safe delivery of approved code from merge through production verification

sre-agent.description: Production system monitoring and incident response

metrics-agent.description: Collect, aggregate, and report on agent swarm performance

swarm-coordinator-agent.description: Coordinates the full agent swarm across issues
